name: Material-Led Commerce
designThesis: Tactile, product-celebrating digital merchandising architecture. Emphasizes authentic product geometry, crisp imagery bounding, transparent specification matrices, and friction-free transactional ergonomics.
bestFitContexts: Architectural materials catalog and ordering portals

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Neutral optical white (#ffffff) or warm stone (#f7f7f5) in light; velvety deep space (#0a0a0c) in dark
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Single checkout / primary CTA accent; secondary actions remain architectural neutral
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 4.5:1 AA on product spec labels; 7.0:1 AAA on pricing and primary CTA

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Clean Swiss neo-grotesque (Inter, Neue Haas Grotesk, Helvetica Now) with tabular numerals for prices
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: Clear typographic hierarchy separating product name, price, stock availability, and technical specs
typographyStrategy.scaleFactor: 1.200 (Minor Third) scale with crisp price display

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Dynamic 12-column product grid with sticky purchase summary rail and horizontal specification comparison tables
layoutRhythm.whitespaceDiscipline: Generous product framing whitespace; product imagery bounded in fixed aspect ratios (1:1, 4:3, 16:9)

surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px clean boundary borders (var(--ot-border-subtle)); zero blurry drop shadows around imagery
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Flat product cards with crisp 1px border highlight on hover; floating sticky action bar on mobile

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Prominent Add to Cart / Order CTA with explicit loading and optimistic cart badge feedback
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Clean image-first card with aspect-ratio enclosure, badge overlay, title, price, and instant action
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Structured technical specification matrix with alternating subtle rows and clear unit column

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Accessible image gallery with arrow key navigation; live announcer for cart addition; modal dialog for quick-view
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Image carousel sliding transitions replaced with instant swap

antiPatterns: Fake countdown urgency timers and spammy popups
Unbounded product images causing cumulative layout shift (CLS)
Hiding technical specs behind multiple nested accordion clicks
Emoji ratings instead of accessible SVG star reviews

browserChecks: Verify CLS = 0 during image asset loading
Verify cart quantity FSM prevents double-submission race conditions
Verify mobile sticky checkout bar does not obscure primary content
